subject: Consolidated stakeholder walkthrough — request to move and expand panel
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@cobalthealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated stakeholder walkthrough — request to move and expand panel

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the time last week. We currently have the technical demo scheduled for Tue, 7 Jun at 10:00 AM PT (invited: Samir, Priya). I heard back from Marissa and Aditya that they can host a condensed walkthrough focused on integration, security controls, and procurement flows.

A couple of asks from our side before we proceed:
- Would Cobalt be comfortable combining the initial product demo and a short security/infra Q&A into a single 60–75 minute session so your wider reviewers (security, infra, procurement) can attend once rather than multiple smaller sessions?
- If yes, can you confirm which internal stakeholders will attend and whether any of them are traveling the week of Jun 7–11? That will determine availability.
- We can include a concise checklist and a one-page network diagram before the meeting — I’ve attached high-level stubs.

If consolidation works, Marissa will lead the product portion and Aditya will handle security and deployment questions. If you prefer separate meetings, we can split into a 30m product demo + 30m security follow-up, but that usually slows decision cycles.

Propose a quick confirm by EOD Monday so we can update calendars. If we need to move the original slot, we’re flexible for the week of Jun 14 as backup.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf) — one-page highlights; network-diagram-stub.png (png) — schematic
From: Samir Rao <samir@cobalthealth.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@cobalthealth.io>, procurement@cobalthealth.io
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:46:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Consolidated stakeholder walkthrough — request to move and expand panel

Kimberly —

Appreciate the note and the attachments — helpful. Quick update from our end: we need to enlarge the panel. Security (Priya) and Procurement (procurement@cobalthealth.io) both need to be in the room for any demo that covers data handling and billing/contract terms. Our infra lead (Jorge M.) is traveling June 7–9, which conflicts with the current slot. Jorge returns on Jun 10 but has limited afternoon availability the week of Jun 14 due to travel.

Given that, can we do one of the following:
1) Move the consolidated 60–75m session to Thu, 17 Jun (morning PT) so everyone including Jorge can attend; or
2) Keep the Jun 7 slot as a 30m product-only demo (no procurement/security) and schedule a follow-up security/procurement deep-dive the week of Jun 14 when Jorge is back.

Procurement also asked for a short MAP (mutual action plan) and a statement on data residency before they commit to the 75m session. I copied them so they can flag anything else.

Prefer option (1) if Redwood can accommodate — fewer handoffs for us.

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Head of Integrations | Cobalt Health
samir@cobalthealth.io | (212) 555-0148

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidated stakeholder walkthrough — request to move and expand panel

Samir —

Thanks for the quick clarity. Option (1) — a single consolidated session — works for us and is preferable. Thu, 17 Jun (morning PT) is currently open on our side. I’ve provisionally blocked 17 Jun 09:00–10:15 PT on our calendar and sent a tentative hold to the attendees.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I’ll circulate a short MAP draft (attached) and a one-line note on data residency (we keep customer data in region by default; details in MAP).
- Aditya will prepare a short slide on network isolation, encryption in transit/at rest, and our SOC2 scope (~10 min).
- Dev will bring anything infra-specific (VPC peering, egress controls) and be available for Q&A.

Samir, can you confirm by EOD Tue, 31 May whether Thu, 17 Jun 09:00–10:15 PT is a firm slot for Cobalt and whether procurement needs any additional artifacts ahead of time (e.g., sample SOW, billing cadence examples)? If anyone else from Cobalt should be on the invite (legal, vendor risk), please add them so we have a complete list.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior AE | Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-draft.xlsx (xlsx) — MAP v0.2
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Consolidated stakeholder walkthrough — request to move and expand panel

Looping in Priya specifically on security artifacts — Priya, see the SOC2-summary.pdf attached earlier and the MAP in the hold. I can slot ~10–12 minutes for a security deep-dive and stay on to answer infra questions.

If procurement needs a sample SOW and billing cadence we can pull a redacted example and share by Wed. Kimberly — I can take the lead on the MAP edits once Samir confirms the attendee list.
